This is the true power of the 'White Lightning'!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Told ya so! I feel top-notch!
We gotta throw a grand victory bash today!
choice_data_list: Tell me whatever you'd like to eat.
Just let me know whatever you want to eat.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
For real?! Anything at all?!
I ain't gonna hold back, so prepare yourself!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
First off is okonomiyaki, then takoyaki,
udon, and horumonyaki...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, that's just the usual then, c'mon!
Hehe, I won't ask for too much, let's just have fun!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Course I will! Not just the next one,
I'm gonna win the one after that, and the one after that too!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's go train
before I lose the feel of the race!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna make such a name for myself that they'll call me the best in Japan! Ain't no stoppin' me now!
